newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn sets auction for 3.50 pct, 2-yr T-notes.
newsitem.headline: Bonn sets auction for 3.50 pct, 2-yr T-notes.

text.p: The German government on Tuesday set an auction for about 10 billion marks of two-year Treasury notes maturing June 18, 1999 with a coupon of 3.50 percent, the Bundesbank as issuing agent said on Tuesday.
Bids for the notes are due by June 18 at 0900 GMT and the pay date is Friday June 20. The notes will be listed on stock exchanges on Monday, June 23.
The first interest payment will be made on June 18, 1998. The securities number is 113678.
